The company, together with Dongyang Jingce Xitong (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., Dongyang Jingce Guoji Co., Ltd., TOYOTech LLC, AeroGT Labs Corporation and Toyo EMC Engineering Co., Ltd., is responsible for this business.
